name: site-header
description: Website header: a brand link, the nav primitive centred beside it, an actions cluster of buttons and links, and a native <details> phone menu that holds a vertical copy of the same nav. Composition only: zero JavaScript, no controller, no reactive directives — the plain/floating/glass styles, the sticky pin and the scroll-condense are pure CSS, the condense a scroll timeline that degrades to the plain sticky bar.

brand.description: Wordmark or logo, linking home. Keep it a link — not a heading, so the header never enters the document outline

nav.description: Wrapper that places a nested data-ui='nav' (aria-label it 'Main'). The nav owns its own [data-part='link'] slots. Hidden on a phone, where the menu panel carries the same links; centred in the row from the md floor

actions.description: End-of-row cluster of nested data-ui='button' and data-ui='link' elements; they keep their own data-variant/data-size and must NOT carry a data-part. Hidden on a phone. The same part name inside the menu panel stacks the actions full width under a rule

menu.description: The phone menu, a native <details>: open and closed with zero JavaScript. Shown below the md floor only

toggle.description: The menu's <summary>, styled as a button with a chevron that turns when the menu is open. Write its text ('Menu'); it is the accessible name

panel.description: The menu's contents: a nested vertical data-ui='nav' with its own accessible name (aria-label 'Main menu'), then an actions part. Drops out of the bar as an overlay rather than pushing the page down

sticky.description: Pin the bar to the top of the viewport (position: sticky, z-index --z-sticky). The floating style pins a beat below the edge so the pill keeps its inset.

condense.description: Start transparent and roomy over the top of the page and settle into the fill, the bottom hairline and the working padding over the first 8rem of scroll — a scroll timeline, no listener. Needs data-sticky to be seen; where scroll timelines are not supported the bar is simply the plain sticky bar.

--site-header-bg.description: The bar's fill, and the menu panel's (custom property). The glass style mixes it to 72% over whatever lies behind.

--site-header-height.description: Minimum height of the bar (custom property); the density ramp moves the default.

--site-header-max.description: Maximum width of the row the brand, nav and actions sit in (custom property). Wider viewports centre it by growing the bar's own inline padding — there is no inner wrapper to size.

required_attrs: the root is a <header> element at the top of the page (banner landmark)
every nested nav has an accessible name via aria-label, and the inline nav and the menu nav use different names
the menu is a <details> whose <summary> carries visible text — that text is the toggle's accessible name
descriptive link text on the brand and on every action (never 'click here')
a11y.notes: The links are written twice — inline nav and menu nav — but CSS shows exactly one copy at a time, so neither the tab order nor the landmark list doubles up. The <summary> toggle is natively focusable and operable with Enter and Space; nothing needs a script. Under reduced motion the toggle stops transitioning; the condense is kept because it only moves as far as the reader's own scrolling moves it.

keyboard.Tab: move through the brand, then the nav links, then the actions in source order (on a phone: the brand, then the menu toggle, then — once open — the panel's links and actions)
keyboard.Enter / Space: on the menu toggle, open or close the panel

templates.html:
{brand}
{link_label}
{secondary_label} {primary_label}
Menu
{link_label}
{primary_label} {secondary_label}

notes: Both navs nest the nav primitive: the <a> elements inside are the NAV's [data-part='link'] slots, not site-header's. The wrapper [data-part='nav'] only places the inline one; the panel holds the vertical one directly.

Nested primitives that carry their own data-variant (nav's vertical, button's primary, link's muted) must not also carry a data-part — a part's data-variant is validated against site-header's variant values.

The menu panel is an absolutely positioned overlay with the header as its containing block, which is why the root is positioned (relative, or sticky with data-sticky) and why a non-sticky header still layers the open panel over the content below it.
Condense is written for the plain and glass styles: its keyframes animate the bottom hairline only, so a floating pill that condenses keeps its other three edges throughout.
The condense distance reads --space-32 (8rem), so a density mode that remaps the spacing scale moves it with everything else.
